name: MemPalace
description: Stores conversation history and project files verbatim in a local, searchable memory palace and serves it to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other clients over MCP.

skills.name: Semantic Search
skills.description: Searches stored drawers by meaning and returns verbatim content with similarity scores, filtered by wing, room or date.

skills.name: Content Mining
skills.description: Mines project files and Claude, ChatGPT or Slack conversation exports into wings and rooms for later recall.

skills.name: Knowledge Graph
skills.description: Adds, queries, invalidates and supersedes time-bounded entity facts in a local SQLite knowledge graph, with timelines.

skills.name: Agent Diaries
skills.description: Writes and reads per-agent diary entries so each specialist agent keeps its own wing and history in the palace.

skills.name: Session Checkpoint
skills.description: Saves a whole session in one call, deduplicating each item, filing new drawers and writing a single diary entry.
